additional_info.subject: ID0459572-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/R9 313202799094] Terminal Fault Issue CRM:03098000157
additional_info.body:
Hello Cedric, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I apologise for the lack of response from my colleague.
I checked the logs from the time you provided and there seems to be a reboot and it's starting up:
The Request Converter Serial Numbers is the 2nd step on booting up the charger.
So in this case, there was nothing wrong with this error besides "showing" that the charger was rebooting.
Let me know if this answered to your question and I can close the ticket.
Again, thank you very much for your patience so far.
Best regards,
Francisco
